outputs.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction.
Asset type: isolated right-hand fingerless leather glove back-of-hand (dorsal) view for Tripo 3D modeling.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET, the existing separated dorsal glove concept.
Primary request: Remove ONLY the surrounding black/brown studio background and its gradient glow, producing a clean cutout on an ACTUAL transparent alpha background. Preserve the SAME single glove exactly as depicted: right-handedness, viewpoint, position, scale, silhouette, all five hollow finger sleeves, hollow wrist cuff, leather grain, stitches, seams, buckle/strap details, colors and original lighting on the glove. Keep the dark inner leather surfaces inside the cuff and finger tubes; these are part of the glove. Only visible exterior background and true background gaps should become transparent.
Composition: maintain the portrait framing and full uncropped glove with margins, wrist at top, fingers at bottom. Do not mirror, rotate, redraw, recolor or redesign the glove. No halo, no gradient, no shadow outside the silhouette, no matte rectangle, no checkerboard baked into pixels, no extra objects, text or watermark.
Critical framing correction: The glove must be ENTIRELY inside the canvas. Keep the original glove's full outline, with transparent padding at least 5% of image width on BOTH left and right and at least 5% height top and bottom. Reduce its displayed size if necessary to ensure these margins; never zoom in. Do not crop off the little-finger opening or the thumb edge. Background removal only, no glove redesign.
